```{=html}
<style>
.adiabatic-trough {
  width: min(1580px, 100%);
  margin: 0.05rem auto 0;
  color: #eef6ff;
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
}

.adiabatic-trough-head {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
}

.adiabatic-trough-lead {
  font-size: 0.72em;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

.adiabatic-trough-lead strong {
  color: #ffffff;
}

.adiabatic-trough-static {
  padding: 0.3rem 0.65rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(102, 209, 255, 0.58);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(21, 104, 145, 0.22);
  color: #8dddff;
  font-size: 0.56em;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.adiabatic-trough-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.75fr) minmax(360px, 0.82fr);
  gap: 18px;
  height: 480px;
}

.adiabatic-trough-card {
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
  border-radius: 15px;
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(12, 31, 53, 0.96), rgba(3, 14, 28, 0.96));
  box-shadow: 0 12px 34px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.22);
}

.adiabatic-trough-channel {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 1fr auto;
}

.adiabatic-trough-svg,
.adiabatic-trough-phase-svg {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
}

.adiabatic-trough-caption {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 1rem;
  padding: 0.34rem 0.7rem 0.42rem;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  color: #c7d8e8;
  font-size: 0.48em;
  line-height: 1.25;
}

.adiabatic-trough-caption strong {
  color: #ffffff;
}

.adiabatic-trough-side {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 245px 1fr;
  gap: 14px;
}

.adiabatic-trough-phase {
  padding: 0.25rem 0.35rem 0.1rem;
}

.adiabatic-trough-energy {
  padding: 0.55rem 0.7rem 0.5rem;
}

.adiabatic-trough-panel-title {
  margin: 0 0 0.35rem;
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 0.55em;
  font-weight: 750;
  letter-spacing: 0.01em;
}

.adiabatic-trough-energy-row {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 92px minmax(0, 1fr) 52px;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  margin: 0.42rem 0;
  font-size: 0.47em;
}

.adiabatic-trough-energy-track {
  height: 19px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
}

.adiabatic-trough-energy-fill {
  width: 50%;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: inherit;
  transition: width 80ms linear;
}

.adiabatic-trough-energy-fill.perp {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #ffb95a, #ff805b);
}

.adiabatic-trough-energy-fill.parallel {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, #56c9ff, #5f8cff);
}

.adiabatic-trough-energy-value {
  color: #ffffff;
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  text-align: right;
}

.adiabatic-trough-equations {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
  padding-top: 0.45rem;
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
  color: #d7e7f5;
  font-size: 0.43em;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.adiabatic-trough-equations .accent {
  color: #ffbc67;
  font-weight: 750;
}

.adiabatic-trough-controls {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 0.7rem;
  margin-top: 0.4rem;
}

.adiabatic-trough-button {
  padding: 0.28rem 0.62rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(102, 209, 255, 0.62);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(44, 144, 190, 0.18);
  color: #dff6ff;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.42em;
  font-weight: 700;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.adiabatic-trough-progress {
  flex: 1;
  height: 5px;
  overflow: hidden;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
}

.adiabatic-trough-progress > span {
  display: block;
  width: 0;
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background: #62d1ff;
}

.adiabatic-trough-axis {
  stroke: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.52);
  stroke-width: 2;
}

.adiabatic-trough-contour {
  fill: none;
  stroke: rgba(88, 180, 229, 0.20);
  stroke-width: 2;
}

.adiabatic-trough-boundary {
  fill: none;
  stroke: rgba(112, 211, 255, 0.76);
  stroke-width: 3;
}

.adiabatic-trough-path {
  fill: none;
  stroke: rgba(255, 184, 92, 0.34);
  stroke-width: 3;
}

.adiabatic-trough-trail {
  fill: none;
  stroke: #ffb85c;
  stroke-width: 5;
  stroke-linecap: round;
}

.adiabatic-trough-particle {
  fill: #ffb85c;
  stroke: #ffffff;
  stroke-width: 3;
}

.adiabatic-trough-arrow-parallel {
  stroke: #63cfff;
  stroke-width: 5;
  stroke-linecap: round;
}

.adiabatic-trough-arrow-perp {
  stroke: #ff8a63;
  stroke-width: 5;
  stroke-linecap: round;
}

.adiabatic-trough-svg-label {
  fill: #dceaf6;
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 650;
}

.adiabatic-trough-svg-muted {
  fill: #9eb6c9;
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
  font-size: 17px;
}

.adiabatic-trough-phase-grid {
  stroke: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  stroke-width: 1;
}

.adiabatic-trough-phase-axis {
  stroke: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
  stroke-width: 2;
}

.adiabatic-trough-phase-ellipse {
  fill: rgba(255, 181, 83, 0.12);
  stroke: #ffb653;
  stroke-width: 4;
}

.adiabatic-trough-phase-dot {
  fill: #ff8760;
  stroke: #ffffff;
  stroke-width: 2;
}

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .adiabatic-trough-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    height: auto;
  }

  .adiabatic-trough-channel {
    min-height: 380px;
  }

  .adiabatic-trough-side {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    grid-template-rows: 270px;
  }
}
</style>

<div class="adiabatic-trough" data-adiabatic-trough>
  <div class="adiabatic-trough-head">
    <div class="adiabatic-trough-lead">
      Материальная точка запущена с \(p_\parallel(0)>0\) вдоль
      <strong>неподвижного</strong> канала. Кривизна поперечного потенциала
      \(k(x)=m\omega^2(x)\) плавно уменьшается.
    </div>
    <div class="adiabatic-trough-static">H = const, J ≃ const</div>
  </div>

  <div class="adiabatic-trough-grid">
    <div class="adiabatic-trough-card adiabatic-trough-channel">
      <svg class="adiabatic-trough-svg" viewBox="0 0 1000 430"
           role="img" aria-label="Частица движется и колеблется в неподвижном канале с плавным профилем">
        <defs>
          <marker id="trough-arrow-blue" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5"
                  markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
            <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#63cfff"></path>
          </marker>
          <marker id="trough-arrow-orange" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5"
                  markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
            <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" fill="#ff8a63"></path>
          </marker>
        </defs>
        <g data-trough-contours aria-hidden="true"></g>
        <path class="adiabatic-trough-boundary" data-trough-upper></path>
        <path class="adiabatic-trough-boundary" data-trough-lower></path>
        <line class="adiabatic-trough-axis" x1="55" y1="215" x2="955" y2="215"></line>
        <path class="adiabatic-trough-path" data-trough-path></path>
        <path class="adiabatic-trough-trail" data-trough-trail></path>
        <line class="adiabatic-trough-arrow-parallel" data-trough-parallel
              marker-end="url(#trough-arrow-blue)"></line>
        <line class="adiabatic-trough-arrow-perp" data-trough-perp
              marker-end="url(#trough-arrow-orange)"></line>
        <circle class="adiabatic-trough-particle" data-trough-particle r="11"></circle>
        <text class="adiabatic-trough-svg-label" x="700" y="42">профиль задан в пространстве</text>
        <text class="adiabatic-trough-svg-muted" x="78" y="400">сильное поперечное удержание</text>
        <text class="adiabatic-trough-svg-muted" x="716" y="400">слабое поперечное удержание</text>
        <text class="adiabatic-trough-svg-label" data-trough-parallel-label>p∥</text>
        <text class="adiabatic-trough-svg-label" data-trough-perp-label>P</text>
      </svg>
      <div class="adiabatic-trough-caption">
        <span><strong>Амплитуда растёт:</strong> \(Q_{\max}\propto\omega^{-1/2}\)</span>
        <span><strong>Поперечный импульс падает:</strong> \(P_{\max}\propto\omega^{1/2}\)</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="adiabatic-trough-side">
      <div class="adiabatic-trough-card adiabatic-trough-phase">
        <div class="adiabatic-trough-panel-title">Фазовый эллипс \((Q,P)\)</div>
        <svg class="adiabatic-trough-phase-svg" viewBox="0 0 500 245"
             role="img" aria-label="Фазовый эллипс расширяется по координате и сжимается по импульсу">
          <g aria-hidden="true">
            <line class="adiabatic-trough-phase-grid" x1="70" y1="60" x2="455" y2="60"></line>
            <line class="adiabatic-trough-phase-grid" x1="70" y1="185" x2="455" y2="185"></line>
            <line class="adiabatic-trough-phase-grid" x1="155" y1="25" x2="155" y2="220"></line>
            <line class="adiabatic-trough-phase-grid" x1="355" y1="25" x2="355" y2="220"></line>
            <line class="adiabatic-trough-phase-axis" x1="55" y1="123" x2="470" y2="123"></line>
            <line class="adiabatic-trough-phase-axis" x1="255" y1="225" x2="255" y2="20"></line>
            <ellipse class="adiabatic-trough-phase-ellipse" data-trough-ellipse
                     cx="255" cy="123" rx="92" ry="75"></ellipse>
            <circle class="adiabatic-trough-phase-dot" data-trough-phase-dot r="8"></circle>
            <text class="adiabatic-trough-svg-label" x="470" y="115">Q</text>
            <text class="adiabatic-trough-svg-label" x="268" y="25">P</text>
            <text class="adiabatic-trough-svg-muted" x="72" y="38">площадь = 2πJ = const</text>
          </g>
        </svg>
      </div>

      <div class="adiabatic-trough-card adiabatic-trough-energy">
        <div class="adiabatic-trough-panel-title">Перераспределение одной полной энергии</div>
        <div class="adiabatic-trough-energy-row">
          <span>\(E_\perp\)</span>
          <div class="adiabatic-trough-energy-track"><div class="adiabatic-trough-energy-fill perp" data-trough-eperp></div></div>
          <span class="adiabatic-trough-energy-value" data-trough-eperp-value></span>
        </div>
        <div class="adiabatic-trough-energy-row">
          <span>\(E_\parallel\)</span>
          <div class="adiabatic-trough-energy-track"><div class="adiabatic-trough-energy-fill parallel" data-trough-eparallel></div></div>
          <span class="adiabatic-trough-energy-value" data-trough-eparallel-value></span>
        </div>
        <div class="adiabatic-trough-equations">
          <div>\(H=E_\parallel+E_\perp,\quad E_\perp=P^2/(2m)+m\omega^2(x)Q^2/2\)</div>
          <div>\(J=E_\perp/\omega\simeq\mathrm{const}\)</div>
          <div><span class="accent">ω ↓ ⇒ E⊥ = Jω ↓</span> ⇒ \(E_\parallel=H-E_\perp ↑\)</div>
        </div>
        <div class="adiabatic-trough-controls">
          <button class="adiabatic-trough-button" type="button" data-trough-toggle>Пауза</button>
          <button class="adiabatic-trough-button" type="button" data-trough-restart>Сначала</button>
          <div class="adiabatic-trough-progress" aria-hidden="true"><span data-trough-progress></span></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>

<script>
(() => {
  const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";

  function initialize(root) {
    if (root.dataset.adiabaticTroughReady === "true") return;
    root.dataset.adiabaticTroughReady = "true";

    const upper = root.querySelector("[data-trough-upper]");
    const lower = root.querySelector("[data-trough-lower]");
    const contourGroup = root.querySelector("[data-trough-contours]");
    const path = root.querySelector("[data-trough-path]");
    const trail = root.querySelector("[data-trough-trail]");
    const particle = root.querySelector("[data-trough-particle]");
    const parallel = root.querySelector("[data-trough-parallel]");
    const perpendicular = root.querySelector("[data-trough-perp]");
    const parallelLabel = root.querySelector("[data-trough-parallel-label]");
    const perpendicularLabel = root.querySelector("[data-trough-perp-label]");
    const ellipse = root.querySelector("[data-trough-ellipse]");
    const phaseDot = root.querySelector("[data-trough-phase-dot]");
    const ePerpFill = root.querySelector("[data-trough-eperp]");
    const eParallelFill = root.querySelector("[data-trough-eparallel]");
    const ePerpValue = root.querySelector("[data-trough-eperp-value]");
    const eParallelValue = root.querySelector("[data-trough-eparallel-value]");
    const toggle = root.querySelector("[data-trough-toggle]");
    const restart = root.querySelector("[data-trough-restart]");
    const progressBar = root.querySelector("[data-trough-progress]");

    const x0 = 72;
    const x1 = 930;
    const centerY = 215;
    const samples = 520;
    const points = [];

    function smoothstep(s) {
      return s * s * (3 - 2 * s);
    }

    function omega(s) {
      return 1 - 0.72 * smoothstep(s);
    }

    function halfWidth(s) {
      return 66 + 106 * smoothstep(s);
    }

    let phase = -Math.PI / 2;
    const phaseScale = 2 * Math.PI * 13 / 0.64;
    for (let i = 0; i <= samples; i += 1) {
      const s = i / samples;
      if (i > 0) {
        const previous = (i - 0.5) / samples;
        phase += phaseScale * omega(previous) / samples;
      }
      const w = omega(s);
      const amplitude = 39 / Math.sqrt(w);
      points.push({
        s: s,
        x: x0 + (x1 - x0) * s,
        y: centerY + amplitude * Math.sin(phase),
        phase: phase,
        w: w,
        amplitude: amplitude
      });
    }

    function linePath(values) {
      return values.map((point, index) =>
        (index === 0 ? "M" : "L") + point[0].toFixed(1) + "," + point[1].toFixed(1)
      ).join(" ");
    }

    const upperPoints = [];
    const lowerPoints = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= 160; i += 1) {
      const s = i / 160;
      const x = x0 + (x1 - x0) * s;
      const width = halfWidth(s);
      upperPoints.push([x, centerY - width]);
      lowerPoints.push([x, centerY + width]);
    }
    upper.setAttribute("d", linePath(upperPoints));
    lower.setAttribute("d", linePath(lowerPoints));
    path.setAttribute("d", linePath(points.map(point => [point.x, point.y])));

    [0.34, 0.60, 0.82].forEach(level => {
      [-1, 1].forEach(sign => {
        const contour = document.createElementNS(NS, "path");
        const contourPoints = upperPoints.map((point, index) => {
          const s = index / (upperPoints.length - 1);
          return [point[0], centerY + sign * halfWidth(s) * level];
        });
        contour.setAttribute("class", "adiabatic-trough-contour");
        contour.setAttribute("d", linePath(contourPoints));
        contourGroup.appendChild(contour);
      });
    });

    let running = true;
    let progress = 0;
    let lastTime = performance.now();
    const duration = 12.5;

    function formatEnergy(value) {
      return value.toFixed(2).replace(".", ",");
    }

    function update(s) {
      const index = Math.min(samples, Math.max(0, Math.round(s * samples)));
      const point = points[index];
      const w = point.w;
      const ePerp = 0.68 * w;
      const eParallel = 1 - ePerp;
      const pParallel = Math.sqrt(eParallel);
      const pPerp = Math.sqrt(w) * Math.cos(point.phase);

      particle.setAttribute("cx", point.x);
      particle.setAttribute("cy", point.y);
      trail.setAttribute("d", linePath(points.slice(Math.max(0, index - 54), index + 1).map(item => [item.x, item.y])));

      const parallelLength = 68 + 55 * pParallel;
      parallel.setAttribute("x1", point.x);
      parallel.setAttribute("y1", point.y);
      parallel.setAttribute("x2", point.x + parallelLength);
      parallel.setAttribute("y2", point.y);
      parallelLabel.setAttribute("x", point.x + parallelLength + 9);
      parallelLabel.setAttribute("y", point.y - 9);

      const perpendicularLength = 68 * pPerp;
      perpendicular.setAttribute("x1", point.x);
      perpendicular.setAttribute("y1", point.y);
      perpendicular.setAttribute("x2", point.x);
      perpendicular.setAttribute("y2", point.y - perpendicularLength);
      perpendicularLabel.setAttribute("x", point.x + 12);
      perpendicularLabel.setAttribute("y", point.y - perpendicularLength + (perpendicularLength >= 0 ? -8 : 23));

      const rx = 86 / Math.sqrt(w);
      const ry = 71 * Math.sqrt(w);
      ellipse.setAttribute("rx", rx);
      ellipse.setAttribute("ry", ry);
      phaseDot.setAttribute("cx", 255 + rx * Math.sin(point.phase));
      phaseDot.setAttribute("cy", 123 - ry * Math.cos(point.phase));

      ePerpFill.style.width = String(100 * ePerp) + "%";
      eParallelFill.style.width = String(100 * eParallel) + "%";
      ePerpValue.textContent = formatEnergy(ePerp);
      eParallelValue.textContent = formatEnergy(eParallel);
      progressBar.style.width = String(100 * s) + "%";
    }

    function isVisible() {
      const slide = root.closest("section");
      return document.visibilityState !== "hidden" && (!slide || slide.classList.contains("present"));
    }

    function frame(now) {
      const dt = Math.min(0.05, Math.max(0, (now - lastTime) / 1000));
      lastTime = now;
      if (running && isVisible()) {
        progress += dt / duration;
        if (progress > 1.08) progress = 0;
        update(Math.min(1, progress));
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    }

    toggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
      running = !running;
      toggle.textContent = running ? "Пауза" : "Продолжить";
    });

    restart.addEventListener("click", () => {
      progress = 0;
      running = true;
      toggle.textContent = "Пауза";
      update(0);
    });

    update(0);
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  document.querySelectorAll("[data-adiabatic-trough]").forEach(initialize);
})();
</script>
```
